name: Eclipse Thunderbird
description: A dual-mode Mythic Attack-type Beyblade capable of switching between Dawn Mode (Right Spin) and Dusk Mode (Left Spin) on ;info. Channels solar flares and lunar eclipses to unleash devastating aerial barrages.

special_move.name: Daytime Blitz
special_move.description: The eight blades shred the opponent for 8 rapid strikes, dealing Special damage equal to 160 + 20% of current Attack, and reduces the opponent's Stability by 30.
flavour_texts: ☀️⚡ **Daytime Blitz** — Eight blades shred through the stadium with blinding speed!

omega_special.name: Final Eclipse Flight
omega_special.description: Usable only during Eclipse Phase. Crashes into the opponent dealing 180 base damage plus 50% of its current modified Attack stat. Upon use, Eclipse Flight becomes permanently Sealed for the remainder of the battle.
flavour_texts: 🌌⚡ **FINAL ECLIPSE FLIGHT** — Eclipse Thunderbird dives from the cosmic zenith for total annihilation!

ability.name: Eclipse Flight
ability.description: Every 3 rounds, Eclipse Thunderbird enters its Eclipse Phase. During this time, it gains a 10% boost to its base Attack and unlocks its Ω Special Move.
